## Summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Scope

- [ ] Manifest
- [ ] README catalog
- [ ] Changelog
- [ ] Workflow or publishing documentation
- [ ] Branding or other assets

## Validation

- [ ] `package.json` parses as valid JSON.
- [ ] Extension IDs were checked against the Marketplace.
- [ ] README links and images were reviewed.
- [ ] Icon dimensions and format were checked.
- [ ] No secrets or generated VSIX files are included.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out compatibility decisions, unavailable IDs, or any intentional deviations from the source curation list.
